hardware: NVIDIA GB10 (SM121), 128 GB unified memory; CUDA 13.0
software: Torch 2.13.0+cu130, vLLM 0.29.0, Transformers 5.17.0, Triton 3.7.1, CuTe DSL 4.8.0
protocol: One engine per device; 48-request warm-up, then one timed pass over every question. Timing: CheckedSession.score (Fissile) or the same vLLM generate call (BF16); one transport token per question.
decision: Four-decimal candidate probabilities, lexical tie break (scripts/benchmark_sglang.py decode_choice)
